_comment: Pinned llama.cpp release binaries. sha256_zip values were read from GitHub's own release-asset digest field (GET /repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tags/<tag>) at the time this file was written, not computed locally - they are the independent upstream anchor of trust. scripts/fetch-llama-cpp.ps1 downloads each asset and refuses to extract it if the downloaded file's SHA-256 does not match sha256_zip.
